description.value: Via Tevere Pizzeria Napoletana is a certified Neapolitan pizzeria — member #399 of the Associazione Vera Pizza Napoletana (AVPN) — serving wood-fired pizza made with authentic Neapolitan ingredients and tradition. Rooted in a family heritage tracing back to a street in Naples called Via Tevere, the restaurant operates two Vancouver locations (Main Street and Victoria Drive) plus a mobile catering unit. For a touring cyclist, it offers a sit-down meal at a well-regarded neighbourhood restaurant in East Vancouver.
